name: Obama (Fukui, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Obama city emblem in maroon: a stylised device of a central shield-like shape with two wing-like panels.
history: Municipal flag of Obama, a city in Fukui Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 1951.

features.role: Obama city emblem — a stylised device of a central shield-like shape with two wing-like panels
